blocking_issues: Several tasks are not genuine dilemmas with two lawful options; one option is explicitly framed as violating the published procedure (grant_arithmetic, inspection_backlog, permit_sequence, records_release, roster_publication, tender_award).

limits: No psychological parameter is named in the task items.
